_note: Mechanics are structured fields, not prose. `damage`/`healing` must be a bare dice expression rollExpression() accepts — a parser reading English is the defect this file exists to avoid. See docs/modules/spells.md.

_resolution.attack: A spell attack roll against the target's armour class.
_resolution.save: The target rolls a saving throw against the caster's spell save DC.
_resolution.auto: No roll — it simply hits (Magic Missile).
_resolution.heal: Restores hit points to an ally.
_resolution.utility: No mechanical outcome the server can compute; the narrator owns it.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: A mote of fire streaks toward a creature or object within range.

spells.name: Ray of Frost
spells.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature, chilling it.

spells.name: Shocking Grasp
spells.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you touch.

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: A ghostly skeletal hand grasps at a creature, and it cannot regain hit points.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature.

spells.name: Produce Flame
spells.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand, shedding light until you hurl it.

spells.name: Thorn Whip
spells.description: A vine of thorns lashes out and pulls the creature closer to you.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature, ignoring cover.

spells.name: Toll the Dead
spells.description: A dolorous bell tolls, and the sound wracks a creature with pain.

spells.name: Poison Spray
spells.description: You fling a puff of noxious gas at a creature.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantment.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: An object you touch sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and it adds a d4 to one ability check.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral hand appears and manipulates objects at a distance.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: You create a sound or an image of an object for a short while.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: A minor magical trick: a spark, a scent, a trinket, a cleaned surface.

spells.name: Druidcraft
spells.description: You predict the weather, or make a flower bloom, or snuff a small flame.

spells.name: Spare the Dying
spells.description: You touch a dying creature and it becomes stable.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three darts of magical force dart unerringly to their target.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: You hurl a sphere of energy of a colour and element you choose.

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.description: A beam of crackling blue energy lances out and arcs to the target.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature and leaves it shimmering.

spells.name: Inflict Wounds
spells.description: Necrotic energy surges through a creature you touch.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: A thin sheet of flames shoots from your outspread fingertips.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out, pushing creatures away.

spells.name: Arms of Hadar
spells.description: Tendrils of dark energy erupt and lash at everything around you.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: You whisper a discordant melody only one creature can hear.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains hit points.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature of your choice regains hit points at the sound of your voice.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add a d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Shield of Faith
spells.description: A shimmering field surrounds a creature, granting it +2 armour class.

spells.name: Faerie Fire
spells.description: Objects and creatures in the area are outlined in light and cannot hide.

spells.name: Entangle
spells.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout and restrain the creatures in the area.

spells.name: Hex
spells.description: You curse a creature, dealing extra necrotic damage when you hit it.

spells.name: Armor of Agathys
spells.description: Protective frost covers you, and harms whoever strikes you.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: A protective magical force surrounds an unarmoured creature.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: An invisible barrier of force briefly grants you +5 armour class.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid, which then regards you as friendly.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Three rays of fire streak toward targets within range.

spells.name: Shatter
spells.description: A sudden ringing noise erupts and painfully rattles everything nearby.

spells.name: Moonbeam
spells.description: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a column.

spells.name: Flaming Sphere
spells.description: A sphere of fire rolls where you direct it and sears what it touches.

spells.name: Heat Metal
spells.description: A manufactured metal object glows red-hot and burns whoever holds it.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: A floating spectral weapon strikes at your command.

spells.name: Prayer of Healing
spells.description: Up to six creatures you can see regain hit points.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: A humanoid you can see is paralysed while the spell lasts.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: Briefly wreathed in silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until it attacks or casts.

spells.name: Lesser Restoration
spells.description: You end one disease or condition afflicting a creature you touch.

spells.name: Mirror Image
spells.description: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear and confuse attackers.
